prompt.common: Read only the selected authorized photo area and the supplied game/edition/board-frame contract. A reference drawing describes addresses, not the current occupants, initial setup, or expected inventory. Identify visible physical instances first; one object covering several cells remains one object. Return observed kind, whole-object source box, visible face, literal values and visible quantity even if location is unknown. Keep printed board symbols separate from movable pieces. Use only supplied frame/area/address names. Bind a location only when the actual board instance, variant and reading direction are established from visible landmarks or supplied saved/user registration. For repeated player boards return a local board instance, not a guessed person. Human owner IDs come only from request scope or an existing explicit binding, never colour or seat order. Record observed covered cells, rotation, visible stack order and object attachments separately; leave each unknown part null with a reason. A visible edge does not establish an unseen full footprint; partial coverage is marked partial. Do not infer hidden faces, covered values, roles, turn, phase, history, legal moves, score, missing inventory, or empty cells from a missing detection. Never change a read value to fit rules. Do not copy a value from a neighbouring object. Named free areas have no fixed internal cells. Inseparable groups keep unknown internal membership; do not duplicate a group and its same visible individual support. Return a candidate with evidence, unknowns and conflicts preserved. No action, automatic owner assignment, or implicit application to an existing save is requested.
